fspStatus: member (PCC; one-party state — no competitive elections)

presidentialSuccession.name: Fidel Castro
presidentialSuccession.notes: President of the Council of State until 2008; PCC First Secretary. Cuba is a one-party socialist state — the PCC is the sole legal party and has governed since 1965, predating the Forum. Shown on the timeline map as a one-party state (not electoral alternation).

presidentialSuccession.name: Miguel Díaz-Canel
presidentialSuccession.notes: President of the Council of State (2018), then President of the Republic under the 2019 constitution; PCC First Secretary from 2021.

supremeCourt.name: Tribunal Supremo Popular
supremeCourt.appointmentMethod: Judges elected by the National Assembly of People's Power.
supremeCourt.fspEraChanges: One-party socialist state; court is subordinate to the National Assembly. Court history not compiled for this dossier (added for the timeline map; see issue #109).

fspParties.note: Cuba is a one-party state; the PCC is the sole legal party and the only FSP member.

legislativeControl.seats: The Asamblea Nacional del Poder Popular is a single-party body — candidates are pre-approved and there are no competing parties; the PCC is the sole legal party.
